# Repository maturity declaration

- **Repository:** owner/name
- **Status:** prototype | alpha | beta | production | maintenance | archived
- **Owner:** GitHub handle
- **Last reviewed:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Next review:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Supported use

State intended users, supported workflows, platforms, and data classifications.

## Explicit non-goals

State what the repository does not promise or support.

## Evidence

- [ ] Locked, reproducible dependencies
- [ ] Automated quality and security checks
- [ ] Unit/integration/end-to-end coverage appropriate to risk
- [ ] Threat model and privacy/data-flow documentation
- [ ] Deployment and rollback procedure
- [ ] Observability and incident ownership
- [ ] Release/support policy
- [ ] Accessibility and documentation review

## Known limitations and risks

List unresolved limitations, risk owners, mitigations, and review dates.

## Advancement criteria

Define the measurable evidence required to move to the next maturity state.
